types.semantics: Exactly the arm selected by Algorithm is populated. NewParameters validates intrinsic algorithm bounds: Argon2id version 19, positive time and parallelism, memory at least eight times parallelism, salt at least eight bytes, output at least sixteen bytes, and BcryptCost 4..31. Composition uses existing NewPolicy to enforce caller-supplied enclosing limits before hashing; DefaultPolicy limits are not universal maxima.

types.name: golibpassword.Secret
types.semantics: Ephemeral mutable secret owner; construction copies input, Use exposes bytes only for one synchronous callback, Destroy clears owned bytes idempotently, and the type has no String, text, JSON, logging or formatting implementation.
